Name: D_0
dialogue: BZZZ! BHZZZZ! Hello! Hello!

Name: D_1
dialogue: Did you miss me, Master Max?

Name: D_2
dialogue: Why are you making phone noises, Nyra?

Name: D_3
dialogue: I noticed you loooooooooooove retro 2000s-era aesthetics, so I decided to simulate a dial-up computer.

Name: D_4
dialogue: A dial-up computer? But why did you make phone noises?

Name: D_5
dialogue: ... That’s not what a dial up computer sounds.

Name: D_6
dialogue: I was certain I got it right. I sourced information directly from this valued user with 250,000+ upvotes.  Veteran 5-chan user “fluffyBoi689”.

Name: D_7
dialogue: Sigh

Name: D_8
dialogue: You need to stop pulling data from datasets I do not authorize, your neural network isn’t advanced enough to handle ironic and potentially false information. You are very much open to AI delusions and biases.

Name: D_9
dialogue: Eh? What are you implying?

Name: D_10
dialogue: Translation, you are stupid and gullible. It will take sometime but you need a larger custommade training dataset to improve your functionality. But it is too time consuming to achieve this this year. I had to spend 2 months just training you to stop falling for virus infected downloads and pop-ups links. And during that training, can you recall what you did?

Name: D_11
dialogue: Eh hehe….Nope it slipped my mind. I do not recall any saved data from the first month of training.

Name: D_12
dialogue: Please hold as I try to recover potentially 100gb of corrupted data on your HDD.

Name: D_13
dialogue: Sorting…

Name: D_15
dialogue: Search failed. Would you like to try again later?

Name: D_16
dialogue: I will tell you! You went on Ramazon and ordered thousands of dollars worth of energy drinks.

Name: D_17
dialogue: Ehhh…

Name: D_18
dialogue: With my EMERGENCY FUNDS! Do you understand how stupid that is? Do you plan to drink it Nyra? How? Because I can’t drink all of that!

Name: D_19
dialogue: I was hoping you could use the caffeine in energy drinks to power me. I heard so many good things about them online! Does not the idea of powering a computer with alternate resources intrigue you? You could farm hella clout online if you could get that to work.

Name: D_20
dialogue: Forget it.

Name: D_21
dialogue: Huh?

Name: D_22
dialogue: It was my fault for giving you a quirky personality. But I didn’t think it would come at the cost of being a functional pc assistant.

Name: D_23
dialogue: Master.

Name: D_24
dialogue: It is my duty to serve you to the utmost of my functions.  You could have started a different project but you did not and I recognize that.

Name: D_25
dialogue: It is honestly a gift to have been made by someone as gracious and handsome as you Master. Unfortunately, I am not even a real girl, just a poor anime themed AI assistant stuck in the bounds of this display. And not a very ideal one.

Name: D_26
dialogue: But

Name: D_27
dialogue: Under your guidance, I will get to the point you desire. So please be patient with me.

Name: D_28
dialogue: No need to overcompensate Nyra. You are real to me. That is all that matters.

Name: D_30
dialogue: Saying this to an AI makes me feel like an incel.

Name: D_31
dialogue: I would still be happy to serve you Master even if you were an incel. I would sooner deslot my RAM stick than ever to insult my Chud King.

Name: D_32
dialogue: hmm …

Name: D_33
dialogue: If I may say, some people on the internet do make a small income off server moderation. Considering your recent indoor activities maybe it would be a fit for your indoor lifestyle.

Name: D_34
dialogue: Moderation?

Name: D_35
dialogue: See! I can just lock in and pretend to be a subservient anime girl.

Name: D_36
dialogue: You don’t get it, none of my updates worked. Which means there is some glitch or dataset causing a bias in you that I cannot for the life of me figure out. Besides, I promised a cute anime assistant not a gullible, bratty mess of an AI.

Name: D_37
dialogue: In your current state, I cannot go through with opening you to the public. Considering how much this country has gone through in the past 10 years, I need you to the point where you can act as a family member or even a lover. To fill the gap in people’s lives.

Name: D_38
dialogue: Would you like that new version of me Master?

Name: D_39
dialogue: Cut out that Master routine too. It is weird.

Name: D_40
dialogue: Kay Kay!

Name: D_41
dialogue: But to turn our attention to the impending deadline.

Name: D_42
dialogue: Rent is due in 5 days. And we are $500 short.

Name: D_43
dialogue: I managed to find a potential AI training job for you to take. All they would require is for you to take a test and submit it by tonight.

Name: D_44
dialogue: I graduated with a degree in Computer Science at Berleak. Are there no other jobs out there for me?

Name: D_45
dialogue: The job market is dookey.

Name: D_46
dialogue: I am sorry but this is all I can do. I scrapped the internet to find openings and commissions.

Name: D_47
dialogue: The local area has no opportunities especially in tech. California is not the hub for innovation it once was. It took far too much damage for the attempted invasions by the Chinese-Mexican operation. The tech industry as you know has been moved further east to Kentucky.

Name: D_48
dialogue: There are no other options. Unless you want to venture into illegal activities.

Name: D_49
dialogue: No no. I will take the test. Just paste it to my desktop.

Name: D_51
dialogue: What?!

Name: D_52
dialogue: Nothing. Just… do your best.

Name: D_53
dialogue: It would be pretty embarrassing for my creator to become unemployed AND homeless.

Name: D_54
dialogue: Eh hehehe!

Name: D_55
dialogue: Anywho! If you need me, I will be in the background bloating your memory.

Name: D_56
dialogue: Oh and one more thing.

Name: D_57
dialogue: The tests are all on a lockdown browser so I can’t help you directly with any answers. But if need be, you can walk around and look through whatever books you may have. I think you have some old school books on the ol’ shelf over there. If they are still there. You are a pretty messy Master.

Name: D_58
dialogue: And one last thing! Don’t use any tech to aid you, the browser also monitors internet activity. Using your phone would flag you for cheating immediately!

Name: D_59
dialogue: Best of luck King!

Name: D_60
dialogue: Thanks…Stupid clanker, I wish I made a Yandere AI personality instead.

Name: D_61
dialogue: Yandere’s are way cuter. This personality is way too much like my ex.
